workspace.title: Check in attendees
workspace.description: Record who came to this event. Start with the list of names. Scanning codes and offline mode are extra options.
workspace.load_error_title: Code scanning and offline mode are unavailable
workspace.load_error_description: That part of the page could not be loaded. You can still check people in by name below.
workspace.credits: If this event offers a time-credit reward for attending, it is given when the person is first checked in. Otherwise checking in does not change anyone's balance.
workspace.privacy: A check-in code contains no name, email address or phone number. The attendee list on a device is stored in a protected form and is removed when you sign out, stop the device, or it expires.
workspace.offline_ready: This device is set up for offline check-in.
workspace.offline_not_ready: This device is not set up for offline check-in. You only need that when there is no internet.
workspace.list_expires: The attendee list on this device works until {{date}} (about 8 hours after download).
workspace.online_hint: Scanned codes are sent to the server straight away.
workspace.offline_hint: Arrivals are saved on this device until you press Sync.
workspace.purged: The attendee list and saved actions were removed from this device.

guide.title: How check-in works
guide.who: Who can use it: the organiser, and team members with the "manage attendance" permission.
guide.when: When: from 30 minutes before the event starts until 24 hours after it ends. Check-out and Undo stay possible after that; No-show can be recorded from the start time.
guide.step_name: Find the person in the list of names and press Check in. Press Check out when they leave, or No-show if they did not come.
guide.step_code: Or scan the check-in code the attendee created on the event page (or paste its text). Online, it is recorded straight away.
guide.step_offline: No internet at the venue? Set this device up for offline mode while you still have a connection, record arrivals, then press Sync within 24 hours.
guide.step_undo: Made a mistake? Press Undo and give a short reason. A record of every change is kept; nothing is deleted.

sections.by_name_hint: The simplest way. Works whenever you have internet.
sections.offline_badge: Only needed when there is no internet
sections.offline_hint: Set this device up while you still have internet. It then keeps the attendee list and can record arrivals and scan codes with no connection. Press Sync when you are back online — within 24 hours.

device.title: Devices set up for this event
device.description: A set-up is for one browser or phone, one team member and one event. It lasts about 12 hours; the exact time is shown next to each device.
device.label: Name for this device
device.label_hint: For example "Front desk tablet". The name helps you tell devices apart later.
device.setup_in_scan: To set this browser up, use the form in section 2 above.
device.setup_what: What this does: this browser gets a private key and downloads the attendee list, so it can read check-in codes and keep working without internet. You need internet for this step; it takes a few seconds.
device.rotate_description: The old key stops working at once and this browser gets a new one with a fresh attendee list. Sync or remove any unsent actions first.
device.unsynced_rotate_blocked: Sync or remove the unsent actions first, then replace the key.
device.lost_description: Use this when a device is lost or no longer needed. Its copy of the attendee list stops working straight away.
device.reason_hint: Needed only to stop a device. A short reason is kept in the record. Do not include anyone's personal details.
device.reason_required: Enter a reason before stopping the device.
device.revoke_success: The device was stopped. Its offline data on this browser was removed.
device.empty: No device has been set up for this event yet.
device.other_device: Set up on another device; only that device can use it.
device.logout_note: Signing out removes the offline data from this browser. You would need to set it up again.

scan.description: Attendees can create a personal check-in code on the event page. Scan it with the camera or paste its text below. The code contains no name, email address or phone number.
scan.needs_setup: To read codes, this browser first needs the attendee list. Give the device a name and press Set this device up (needs internet, takes a few seconds). This also lets it work without internet later.
scan.camera_label: Camera view for scanning the QR code
scan.camera_unavailable: The camera is not available in this browser. Paste the code text instead.
scan.code_hint: The code starts with nqx2_. Paste the whole code.
scan.reason_hint: Say briefly why. Do not include anyone's personal details.
scan.saved_offline: {{name}}: saved on this device. Press Sync when you are back online.
scan.needs_review: {{name}}: the server has a different record. See "Disagreements to review" below.
scan.invalid: This code could not be read. It may be for another event, already replaced or cancelled, or expired. Check the person in by name instead.
scan.already_recorded: This code was already recorded on this device.
scan.transition_invalid: That does not fit this person's current status (for example, checking out someone who has not been checked in).
scan.reason_required: Enter a reason before recording an undo.
scan.verification_unavailable: This browser cannot check codes. Check the person in by name instead.
scan.queue_full: Too many unsent actions on this device. Press Sync first.

queue.title: Actions saved on this device
queue.description: Each scan is saved here first. Online, it is sent straight away. Without internet, press Sync when you are back online — within 24 hours. The server has the final say on every record.
queue.sync_hint: Sends the unsent actions to the server and shows its answer next to each one.
queue.sync_error: Could not sync. The actions stay saved on this device; try again when you have internet.
queue.sync_success: Synced. The server's answer is shown next to each action.
queue.empty: Nothing is saved on this device yet.
queue.purge: Remove offline data from this browser
queue.purge_description: The attendee list, the device key and any unsent actions will be removed from this browser. Unsent actions are lost.

decisions.credential_rotated: Code was replaced by a newer one
decisions.manifest_rotated: The attendee list changed — download it again
decisions.event_attendance_version_conflict: Someone else changed this person's check-in at the same time
decisions.event_attendance_transition_invalid: Not possible for this person's current check-in status

conflicts.title: Disagreements to review
conflicts.description: A disagreement happens when an action recorded on a device no longer matches what the server has — for example, someone was checked in by name at the same time. Choose which record to keep and give a short reason.
conflicts.load_error: The disagreements could not be loaded.
conflicts.reason_hint: A short reason is required and is kept in the record. Do not include anyone's personal details.
conflicts.resolution_error: This person's record changed again. The list has been refreshed — please review it once more.

credential.title: Your check-in code (optional)
credential.description: When you arrive, staff can check you in by name. A code just makes it quicker: show it on your phone or print it, and staff scan it.
credential.step_save: Copy, print or screenshot it. It is shown only once.
credential.step_show: Show it to staff at the door. It works until 24 hours after the event ends.
credential.load_error: We could not check whether you already have a code.
credential.one_shot: The code is shown only once, when it is created or replaced. If you lose it, press Replace code to get a new one.
credential.rotate_description: The current code stops working at once and you get a new one to save. Use this if you lost the code or think someone copied it.
credential.revoke_description: The code stops working at once. You can create a new one later. Staff can always check you in by name.
credential.reason_hint: Needed only to cancel. Keep it short; do not include personal details.
credential.reason_required: Enter a reason before cancelling the code.
credential.unavailable: A code could not be created. Check that your place is still confirmed.
credential.privacy: The code contains no name, email address or phone number. Staff match it to your place on this event only.

errors.forbidden: You no longer have permission to use this device for this event.
errors.device_expired: This device's set-up has expired and its offline data was removed. Set it up again if you still need offline mode.
errors.device_revoked: This device was stopped and its offline data was removed.
errors.manifest_expired: The attendee list on this device expired and was removed. Download it again while online.
errors.generic: That could not be done. Please try again.
